theorem.statement: A platform Evidence bundle is admissible only when all security-relevant artifacts are cross-bound to one capture session, one boot identity, one TPM identity including observed EK public material, one PCR selection, one challenge, one toolchain snapshot, one reference-value version, one trusted-time object, and one event-log reconstruction result.

manifest_bindings.session_binding: The session_binding_sha256 covers the session/boot/TPM/EK/event-log/PCR selection/challenge/AK/toolchain/reference/trusted-time/reconstruction result, exact reconstruction input digest, verifier identifier, verifier source digest, and platform/workload inputs in canonical form.
manifest_bindings.canonical_json: Manifest semantic hashing uses UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and no insignificant whitespace.

coherence_rules.rule: The selected TPM device path, fixed properties, and observed EK public material remain constant throughout the capture.
The boot_id must be stable before and after all TPM capture operations.
The event-log digest must match the event log named by the independent reconstruction result.
Quote PCR selection, reconstruction PCR selection, and live-observation selection must be byte-for-byte identical.
Quote qualifying data must equal the verifier challenge file byte-for-byte; challenge.sha256 and quote.nonce_sha256 must match that file, and challenge origin must not be a local wall-clock claim.
The live PCR values are parsed from the pcr-post artifact and are distinct from the pcr-post file digest.
The live PCR value-set hash must equal the independently reconstructed PCR value-set hash when reconstruction status is PASS.
Quote cryptographic verification, event-log parsing, event-log reconstruction, reference appraisal, trusted time, and authorization remain distinct observations.
Parser success is insufficient: reconstruction must report PASS, bind the exact event-log digest and PCR selection, and bind the reconstructed PCR values to the live PCR values.
Any unavailable or ambiguous trusted-time or reconstruction dependency is INDETERMINATE, never PASS.
Reference-value rollback, profile substitution, artifact substitution, EK substitution, PCR-state substitution, or session-binding mismatch is DENY.
Any DENY anywhere outranks INDETERMINATE; any INDETERMINATE outranks PASS.
A reconstruction PASS must be backed by complete machine-readable PCR maps and state hashes
The reconstruction result is bound to an exact input artifact and verifier source provenance
The platform verifier independently executes the reconstruction theorem and rejects receipt substitution
PCR values used as the observed side of reconstruction must originate from the independently captured tpm2_pcrread artifact, never from tpm2_eventlog's parser-generated trailing pcrs section
The canonical replay observed-PCR map must be sourced from the separately captured TPM pcrread artifact; tpm2_eventlog trailing pcrs output is not an observation source.
The capture command invokes the bounded tpm2_eventlog adapter and independent reconstruction executable; no manually supplied reconstruction receipt is required for the physical capture path.
The raw binary event-log parser must succeed independently of tpm2_eventlog YAML rendering and must bind its binary SHA-256 to the captured eventlog.bin.
The YAML adapter must cross-check EventNum/PCRIndex/EventType and selected SHA-256 digests against the independent raw parser before attaching exact payload bytes.
Payload-digest coherence DENY is a hard platform-evidence failure; INDETERMINATE remains explicit and never becomes PASS.
Payload coherence input and verifier source provenance must bind to the exact canonical reconstruction input and exact verifier source.
Reference-value version and digest alone are insufficient; the exact reference set must pass an independent appraisal against the approved registry.
An unapproved but syntactically valid reference set is INDETERMINATE, while a digest conflict for an approved version is DENY.
The reference-appraisal result is bound to the exact reference-values artifact, registry digest, verifier source, and capture session.
Reference-value version and digest alone are insufficient; the exact reference set must pass independent appraisal against an approved registry.
An unapproved reference set is INDETERMINATE; a digest conflict for an approved version is DENY.
Reference appraisal is bound to the exact reference artifact, registry digest, verifier source, and capture session.

decision_algebra: ANY DENY > ANY INDETERMINATE > ALL PASS

execution_modes.self_test: Deterministic semantic coherence vectors; no hardware claim.
execution_modes.verify: Verify an existing bundle, check artifact hashes, parse exact SHA-256 PCR values from pcr-post.yaml, validate reconstruction bindings, and cryptographically check the TPM Quote when tpm2_checkquote is available.
execution_modes.capture: Capture raw physical TPM/PC-client artifacts when compatible hardware and tools exist. The result remains unqualified until independent reconstruction and trusted-time evidence are valid.

capture_requirements.workload_pcr_note: PCR16 remains a separate workload-specific measurement surface and is not silently treated as a PC-client firmware event-log PCR.

reference_boundary.event_log_semantics: The PC-client event log is an input to reconstruction; parsing alone is not a trust decision.
reference_boundary.reference_values: Reference values are independently appraised. In ReferenceModelOnly the reviewed static registry authorizes an exact fixture digest; dynamic provider authentication remains a separate future theorem.
reference_boundary.trusted_time: Trusted time is an externally qualified evidence object; local wall-clock time is not authoritative.
reference_boundary.authorization: Coherent platform Evidence remains evidence only and is consumed by the downstream RATS/Relying-Party/PEP chain.
